_comment: AUDIT FINDINGS — Bella's diagnosis, structured so the CRM can show it on the client's record page. Written once at the Audit and amended only with a dated note; it is the BASELINE the outcomes ledger measures against, so rewriting it retroactively destroys every ROI claim built on it.

findings._example: delete this row before the first real finding
findings.bottleneck: Quotes take 6 weeks; deals cool and die in the gap
findings.evidence: Aspire export: median 42 days from site visit to priced quote across 31 jobs
findings.costBasis: 31 jobs/yr x $27.5k avg x 20% net x ~1 in 5 lost to the delay

_fields: id (stable — outcomes link to it by findingId) · pillar (one of the 8) · bottleneck (the problem in their words) · evidence (what makes it true, re-derivable) · annualCost ($/yr — the baseline) · costBasis (the arithmetic, shown) · confidence: measured | estimated | stated (stated = they said it, we did not verify) · proposedModule · status: open | in build | solved
